new.statement: Games selling spins or crates rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Young creature and monster-themed games hold higher Top Trending positions among games of similar age, even though they climb no faster (H-tt-022)
Games built around drivable vehicles earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
The ragdoll wave is branching into single-effect physics showcases (soft-body car crashes, fluid blood, tornado simulation) that reach Up-and-Coming within their first month
new.action: Build around one standout physics effect
new.rationale: Profiled today: BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] (31 days, soft-body deformation, Up-and-Coming #35), Blood Lab (14 days, voxel fluid blood, #73) and Tornado Ragdoll Sandbox (12 days, tornado simulation, #44) all entered Up-and-Coming on the same day, next to Ragdoll Destruction Playground (10 days, #22). Confirm if by 2026-11-27 at least two of them reach Top Trending or Most Popular, or more single-effect physics showcases enter Up-and-Coming; refute if all four leave Up-and-Coming within two weeks without reaching another chart.

new.statement: School role-reversal games, where players act as the teacher or sneak past one (grade homework, catch cheaters, sneak snacks), are a new breakout theme on Up-and-Coming
new.rationale: Two school-themed games entered Up-and-Coming on the same day at 15-17 days old from different groups: Be a Teacher! (#19, a job sim with a Papers-Please-style inspection gate) and Class Clowns (#34, a 1-vs-all classroom stealth game where one player is the teacher). Confirm if a third school role-reversal game enters a breakout chart, or either reaches Top Trending, by 2026-11-27; refute if both leave Up-and-Coming within ten days.

qualitative_updates.note: The wave still feeds every breakout chart: Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (15 days) leads Up-and-Coming and rose 21 on Most Popular, and four physics sandboxes aged 10-31 days entered Up-and-Coming today, while physics-sandbox loops stay the least efficient on Top Earning (r=-0.55, median percentile 14).

Replacement runs even faster than four weeks: Ragdoll Realism (17 days) rose 47 on Most Popular yesterday, then fell 46 today and 33 on Up-and-Coming, and Bad Physics (15 days) fell 50 on Up-and-Coming, while three newer ones (10-14 days) entered Up-and-Coming.

Five games profiled today carry an hourglass countdown icon, now in more genres: a bike racer (Ride a Bike Downhill, NOW), a lucky-block PvP game (Lucky Islands, 24 HOURS), a football game (Huss Tackle, 6 HOURS), a gym simulator (Gym Legacy, 17 HOURS) and a steal game (Steal a Cheese, 24 HOURS). Most show a time left in hours, not just NOW.

Another MALAM SAMA series entry, Malam Sama Kembar (14 days, Malay-language twins horror), entered Up-and-Coming at #79, while MALAM SAMA OPAH (24 days) is among the least efficient games on Top Earning.

Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular, but new steal reskins stay weak where they launch: Risky Heist (15 days) is among the four weakest on Up-and-Coming, and Steal a Cheese (51 days) entered Top Earning only at #480. Steal-and-defend loops have a median percentile of 29 on Up-and-Coming and 24 on Top Earning.
Flee the Facility fell 25 on Most Popular three days after its late Halloween bump, and Momo City, Legacy Piece and something evil will happen (all pumpkin-tagged) fell off Top Earning today.
